name: CliftonStrengths (formerly StrengthsFinder)
description: A 177-item assessment identifying an individual's top 5 (or all 34) talent themes across four domains: Executing, Influencing, Relationship Building, and Strategic Thinking.
reputation: 35M+ people assessed; Gallup's flagship individual development tool; strong engagement link.
notes: Proprietary; paid access required; some themes overlap; optimistic framing may mask weaknesses.
